stop_rule: stop real flying after 4 failed real flights per iteration; a NOT_RUN for capacity counts

L1_long_soak.gpu: NVIDIA RTX A4000 first; alternatives A5000, L4, 4090, A40
L1_long_soak.controller: poll 10 s, platform samples every 10 s, module windows every 10 s, checkpoints every 600 s (4 MiB)
L1_long_soak.controller_kill: os._exit(137) at +1500 s after first telemetry; ~120 s with no controller; then --resume from the ledger

predictions.P1_duration: module elapsed 3900 s (+/- 2 s); pod wall <= module + 300 s
predictions.P2_cost: <= $0.22 on an A4000 (quoted $0.17/h, ~72 min of pod); <= $0.62 on the worst alternative (A40)
predictions.P3_device_memory: CuPy pool held bytes IDENTICAL from window 30 to the end (no creep); driver free bytes within 64 MiB of their window-30 value
predictions.P4_host_memory: module VmRSS in the last 10 windows within 5% of windows 30-39
predictions.P5_throughput: window p50 step latency, last 30 windows vs windows 30-59 (after a 5-min thermal settle): within 5%
predictions.P6_tail_latency: p99/p50 ratio per window below 1.5 in >= 95% of windows
predictions.P7_telemetry_cadence: no gap > 30 s (3 intervals) between consecutive module progress records, INCLUDING across the controller gap; platform sampler cost p50 in the last 10 min within 2x of the first 10 min
predictions.P8_artifact_growth: series.jsonl grows ~linearly to 390 +/- 2 rows; 6 checkpoints written; artifact dir peak 25-40 MB; every declared artifact VERIFIED against /_manifest
predictions.P9_provider_latency: per operation, second-half p50 within 2x of first-half p50; failures < 5% of calls
predictions.P10_clock: start and end pod-clock offsets agree within 0.5 s (Iteration 2: 0.04 s over 10 min)
predictions.P11_controller_state: the killed controller leaves the pod running and the ledger naming it; the resumed controller finds it by GET with a matching name, creates nothing (1 create total), watches to the module's end, retrieves, and establishes absence by LIST and GET together
predictions.P12_spend_accounting: the last controller-health spend and the receipt's cost agree within 2%

L1_long_soak.falsified_if: any P fails; each is reported individually, and a failure is a finding about the platform, not a reason to re-fly

F1_exit_nonzero.predict: result FAILED, cause MODULE_EXITED_WITHOUT_END, detected within 2 watch polls (<= 20 s) of the exit, well before max_runtime; cleanup LIST+GET absent; cost <= $0.02
F1_exit_nonzero.qualifies: the stage-file exit path through the real proxy

F2_artifact_server_killed.predict: result UNKNOWN, cause ARTIFACT_SERVER_UNREACHABLE after ~120 s of silence while GET still returns the pod; telemetry up to ~60 s retained; artifacts MISSING (absent), not mismatched; cleanup LIST+GET absent; cost <= $0.02
F2_artifact_server_killed.qualifies: what the real RunPod proxy returns for a dead backend (status recorded), and the controller's unreachable path

F3_hang.predict: result ABORTED, cause TELEMETRY_STALLED ~120-130 s after the last progress record; artifacts: telemetry VERIFIED (it is not being written), result.json MISSING; cleanup absent; cost <= $0.02
F3_hang.qualifies: hang detection against a live pod whose server keeps answering

A1_auto_chain.predict: one command runs scout -> calibrated plan -> pinned campaign; the receipt carries estimates{spec_sheet, scout, actual, both errors}; |scout error| < |spec-sheet error| unless the A4000 is the card (spec sheet was only 2.9% off there in Iteration 2)
A1_auto_chain.qualifies: the feedback-loop path as the easy default

iteration_4.shards: 3 x examples/soak, 240 s each, seeds 1/2/3; shard c injects exit at 60 s
iteration_4.predict: campaign PARTIAL: a and b OK with verified artifacts, c FAILED (MODULE_EXITED_WITHOUT_END); 3 distinct pods, 3 distinct run ids, every shard's own cleanup LIST+GET absent; campaign cost = sum of shard costs <= $0.12 on A4000-class cards; a and b unaffected by c (their module elapsed within 2% of 240 s)
